clock_units.native_event: start_ns/end_ns monotonic nanoseconds relative to each prefill/decode trace start; wall alignment uses nearby prefill_epoch/decode_epoch Unix seconds
clock_units.disk_job: steady_clock nanoseconds relative to start of the C++ batch, not native trace epoch
clock_units.components_csv: min/p50/p90/p95/p99/max/total are inclusive host wall nanoseconds; count is event count; host_self_total_ns excludes direct child spans

native_event.name: scope or completion stage name
native_event.parent: earlier array index or null; nested spans overlap by design
native_event.data: null or metadata (actual routes/slots/hits, jobs, shapes, output steps)

roles: nearest layer_0..47 is target; layer=null scopes under mtp_head_proposal/cache/prefill extend are head, other null scopes are global
route_fields: 10 unique experts per row, rows1 or2; cold occurrences may duplicate an expert across two rows, deduplicated disk jobs are separately counted
vm: Compressions/Decompressions count system pages/events; do not interpret as compressed physical byte sizes. Swapins/Swapouts pages * recorded page size = new swap bytes. Compressor occupied pages is a gauge, may decrease. Windows bounded by synchronous snapshots outside clocks, include snapshot overhead; not model exclusive.
memory: physical process footprint and lifetime peak differ from RSS and MLX active/cache/peak allocations; do not sum them
mtp: 127 emitted decode steps include near-zero queued outputs. Report all-step and actual-model-call distributions separately; proposals, accepted and blocks are per phase. verify_pair covers the target model, not pure overhead.
fences: fenced stages eval real arrays and alter overlap/fusion/launch frequency. These are component completion wall costs incl dispatch/wait; they are not exclusive GPU hardware counters, and not release TPS.
natural: no added GPU evals; nested host spans/JSON metadata collection impose overhead, compared to adjacent untraced unit controls and fresh release controls. LFU weights/ages persist between six resets.
quality: nonempty finite 248320 logits/all target and MTP head state bytes checked each phase against first untraced phase; natural128 additionally exact external text/hash; fenced33 checked against exact natural token prefix. Independent model/pair/session oracles precede campaigns.
limits: no per-model physical NVMe traffic or GPU frequency
global system observations do not attribute activity to an application
the two fixed prompts and contexts do not represent all production workloads
quantile_method: empirical nearest rank ceil(p*n)-1, zero samples retained
exports: exports/*.csv; ns for component/worker distributions; output_step.seconds and phase clocks seconds; layer_role head separate; acceptance intervals by block start decoded step
csv_record_endings: CRLF (standard Python csv dialect); Git source whitespace validation allows cr-at-eol only, keeping other checks
